chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام was asked about a eunuch who urinates, then encounters difficulty because of that, and sees wetness after wetness.
He said: 'He should perform wudu (ablution), then sprinkle his garment once during the day.'

key_terms.الْبَلَلَ: wetness or moisture noticed on the body or clothing

ai.seo_question: What should a person with recurring wetness after urination do regarding wudu (ablution) and clothing purity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person who suffers recurring wetness associated with urination. Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام instructs him to perform wudu (ablution) and to sprinkle his garment with water once during the day, indicating a practical ruling concerning ritual purity and hardship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.168 - Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) was asked about a eunuch who experiences difficulty with urination and notices wetness repeatedly.
Imam (as) replied: 'He should perform ablution and sprinkle his clothing with water once during the day.'.
